qAndA.answer: The name 'Mee Racun' translates to 'poison noodles' in Malay. Greg explains that the name is a playful way to get people's attention and doesn't imply the dish is actually poisonous.
qAndA.question: Why is the Mee Racun dish called 'poison noodles'?
